Read the [pattern lifecycle](https://github.com/scanalesespinoza/adev/blob/main/patterns/README.md) first. A pull request that adds the candidate to `patterns/` is even better than an issue.

## Pattern

One observable statement, in the imperative.

## Context

When it applies, and when it does not.

## Evidence

Dates and a sanitized summary of what was observed, including counter-evidence. No names, customers, internal hosts, or raw logs.

## Narrowest layer

Where it would belong if adopted: an overlay, a practice, a default, or the core, and why.
